provenance: SIMULATED DEMO: procedurally authored artwork and scripted interpretations. No image or vision model was run. Not experimental evidence.
prompt: A luminous red ring floating above a dark blue pool at night.

frames.caption: A luminous red ring floats above a dark blue pool, its reflection trembling across the water.
A red halo hovers over rippling water, dissolving into a thin ribbon of light.
A ribbon of warm light curves above a blue horizon in a field of darkness.
Two luminous ribbons cross a quiet horizon, forming an open arch.
An arch of copper light encloses a deep blue opening with fine wave patterns.
A glowing doorway opens into a layered sea of blue and violet waves.
Violet waves curl through a luminous opening, resembling a spiral shell.
A spiral of violet and gold filaments floats in a dark, empty space.
A golden vortex gathers delicate violet threads around a hollow centre.
A hollow golden eye is surrounded by concentric blue and violet ripples.
An iris of fine luminous lines opens into a black circular void.
A black sun radiates silver and pale blue filaments into darkness.
Silver rays bend into an orbit around an invisible central body.
An orbital cloud of pale blue threads stretches into a flowing river.
A river of luminous threads flows across a black field, gathering into a knot.
A dense knot of blue and amber light unravels into a delicate arc.
An amber arc encloses a blue reflection, suspended against black.
A red ring returns above dark blue waves, its outline scattered into fine light.
